title: Old Fashioned Snappy Russian Yukon Gold Potatoes Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring Yukon gold potatoes, these dumplings are filled with umami flavor and have a delightful snappy texture, making them a romantic and satisfying meal.
instructions: Combine grated potatoes, flour, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add chopped onion, mushroom broth, and chopped fresh dill to the bowl and mix well.
Add beaten egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fold in half to form a half moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot with vegetable oil.
